ImagePlaceholder.description: Clean local image placeholder. Use whenever a photo, product image, illustration, thumbnail or avatar is requested. Optional contextual label and aspect: landscape (default), portrait, square, wide or avatar. No URL, image search or network request.

DataList.signature: DataList(items: {id: string, title: string, description?: string, status?: string}[], controls?: {search?: boolean, filterBy?: string[], sort?: boolean, pageSize?: number})
DataList.description: Local searchable/filterable/sortable list. items: [{id,title,description?,status?}], controls: {search:true,filterBy:["Status"],sort:true,pageSize:5}. Uses provided data only.

AppShell.signature: AppShell(brand: string, navigation: {id: string, label?: string, items: {id: string, label: string, icon?: string}[]}[], title: string, children: Node[], user?: {name: string, detail?: string})
AppShell.description: AppShell(brand, navigation, title, children, user). Contained desktop sidebar + page header + flexible content. navigation is [{id,label,items:[{id,label,icon}]}], unique stable group/item ids; icons are lucide names. user is optional {name,detail}. Local selection/collapse only; does not change page content. Put directly inside Page, never nest shells.

MetricCards.signature: MetricCards(items: {id: string, label: string, value: string, description?: string, trend?: string}[], highlightedId?: string)
MetricCards.description: MetricCards(items, highlightedId). Responsive dashboard KPI cards. items are [{id,label,value,description?,trend?}], unique stable ids, string values; preserves item count. highlightedId optionally gives exactly one item an accent surface. Not a generic pricing/result card; use Card for custom content.

DashboardSection.signature: DashboardSection(children: Node[], title?: string, description?: string, actions?: Buttons)
DashboardSection.description: DashboardSection(children, title, description, actions). Flexible dashboard section with optional compact heading, supporting description and Buttons action group. Children can be charts, tables, forms or any registered content. No forced outer card. Also works outside AppShell.

AuthLayout.signature: AuthLayout(mode: "login" | "signup", brand: string, children: Node[], title?: string, description?: string, supportingText?: string)
AuthLayout.description: AuthLayout(mode, brand, children, title, description, supportingText). Centered login/signup layout adapted from shadcn. children should contain one existing Form, not another Card/AuthLayout. mode login/signup sets default title. Content remains configurable. No actual authentication, OAuth, network submission or external links.

Page.description: Root page container; stacks content vertically. Gap is in 4px units.

Column.description: Vertical layout for any registered content.

Row.signature: Row(children: Node[], gap?: number, align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between", wrap?: boolean)
Row.description: Horizontal layout: children, numeric gap, align, justify, wrap. Use Grid for equal-width cards.

Grid.signature: Grid(children: Node[], columns?: number, minWidth?: number, gap?: number)
Grid.description: Equal-width grid: children, columns (1-12), minWidth in px (default 220), gap in 4px units. Use for KPI cards and pricing plans.

Section.description: Semantic section that stacks children vertically.

Card.signature: Card(children: Node[], title?: string, description?: string, tone?: "default" | "muted" | "accent")
Card.description: Card(children, title, description, tone). Nestable shadcn surface with optional header. tone default/muted/accent; use accent for at most one recommended or featured item, muted for supporting content. No padding argument.

Icon.description: Decorative lucide icon by kebab-case name.

CardHeader.description: Title/description header block for a Card.

TextContent.description: Text block with optional size. size: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy" | "metric". metric is a large unbroken KPI number.

MarkDownRenderer.description: Renders markdown text with GFM support.

Alert.description: Alert banner with icon, title, and description. variant: "default" | "destructive" | "info" | "success" | "warning".

Avatar.description: Circular avatar with image and fallback text.

CodeBlock.signature: CodeBlock(code: string, language?: string, title?: string)
CodeBlock.description: Syntax-highlighted code block with optional language and title.

Progress.signature: Progress(value: number, label?: string, showValue?: boolean)
Progress.description: Progress(value, label, showValue). Completion percentage only, not a flight path or duration. showValue defaults true; false hides the printed percentage.

Table.signature: Table(columns: TableColumn[], rows: any[][], pageSize?: number, controls?: {search?: boolean, filterBy?: string[], sort?: boolean, pageSize?: number})
Table.description: Data table. columns: TableColumn[], rows: 2D array, pageSize?, controls?: {search:true,filterBy:["Status"],sort:true}. Built-in local controls work together on supplied rows.

TableColumn.description: Column definition for Table — header label and optional type.

BarChart.signature: BarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "grouped" | "stacked", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string)
BarChart.description: Vertical bar chart. Use for comparing values across categories.

LineChart.signature: LineChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string)
LineChart.description: Line chart for trends over categories.

AreaChart.signature: AreaChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string)
AreaChart.description: Area chart for showing volume over categories.

Series.description: One named data series with values matching labels.

PieChart.description: Pie or donut chart. slices: Slice[], donut: boolean for ring chart.

RadialChart.description: Radial bar chart for displaying categorized values in rings.

Slice.description: A single slice in a PieChart or RadialChart.

ScatterChart.signature: ScatterChart(series: ScatterSeries[], xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string)
ScatterChart.description: Scatter plot with named series of Point references.

ScatterSeries.description: Named scatter series with Point references.

Point.signature: Point(x: number, y: number, label?: string)
Point.description: A single data point in a ScatterChart series.

Form.description: Form(name, buttons, fields, columns). Optional columns (1-6) arranges fields in a responsive equal-width grid; default 1. Optional fifth defaults object sets initial values by field name. Use 2-4 for compact desktop search/filter forms. Buttons remain below the fields.

FormControl.description: Labels a named field and shows local validation errors.

Label.description: Form label. Optionally links to an input via htmlFor.

Input.description: Text input field. type: "text" | "email" | "password" | "number" | "url". rules for validation.

TextArea.description: Multi-line text input. rows sets visible height. rules for validation.

Select.signature: Select(name: string, items: SelectItem[], placeholder?: string, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string})
Select.description: Dropdown select. items: SelectItem[], placeholder, rules for validation.

DatePicker.description: Date selection input with calendar popover.

Slider.signature: Slider(name: string, min?: number, max?: number, step?: number, defaultValue?: number)
Slider.description: Range slider input. min, max, step, defaultValue.

CheckBoxGroup.signature: CheckBoxGroup(name: string, items: CheckBoxItem[], rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string})

SwitchGroup.description: Group of toggle switches. items: SwitchItem[].

Button.signature: Button(label: string, action?: {type: "continue_conversation"}, variant?: "default" | "destructive" | "outline" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "link", size?: "default" | "xs" | "sm" | "lg" | "icon", behavior?: "submit" | "reset")
Button.description: Clickable button. variant: "default" | "destructive" | "outline" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "link". size: "default" | "xs" | "sm" | "lg" | "icon". Optional fifth behavior submit/reset validates or resets local form fields; no backend.

Tabs.description: Tabbed content. items: TabItem[]. defaultValue: initially active tab.

TabItem.signature: TabItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: Node[])
TabItem.description: Tab panel. value: unique id, trigger: tab label, content: children.

AccordionItem.signature: AccordionItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: Node[])
AccordionItem.description: Collapsible item inside Accordion. value: unique id, trigger: header text.

Carousel.description: Horizontal sliding content. slides: array of slide arrays. variant: "default" | "card".

TagBlock.description: Group of tags. Accepts string array or Tag references.

Heading.description: Heading(text, level, size). Semantic level h1-h4 is independent of visual size sm/md/lg/xl. Default h1 uses lg, h2 uses md, h3/h4 use sm. xl is reserved for short hero headings.

Blockquote.description: Styled blockquote. Optional cite for attribution.

InlineCode.description: Inline code snippet rendered with monospace font.

PaginationBlock.description: Page navigation. currentPage and totalPages control which pages are shown.
